name: ENN Energy Holdings Limited
summary: ENN Energy Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the investment, construction, operation, and management of gas pipeline infrastructure in the People's Republic of China. It operates through Retail Gas Sales Business, Integrated Energy Business, Wholesale of Gas, Construction and Installation, and Smart Home Business segments. The company distributes and sells piped gas, liquefied natural gas (LNG), and other multi-energy products; operates vehicle gas refueling stations; and provides services related to low-carbon integrated solutions.
